run_attention_iex: run the IPEX attention function with query key value tensors and a KV cache for variable length sequences
run_paged_attention_iex: run the IPEX paged attention function with a query tensor KV cache and block tables for cached key-value attention
check_supports_windowing: check the SUPPORTS_WINDOWING constant to see if sliding window attention is supported by the current IPEX backend
refactor_attention_flashdecoding: refactor the attention function to support a new IPEX flash decoding backend with window size and softcap parameters
review_paged_attention_fp8: review the paged_attention function to understand how FP8 KV cache dtypes are detected and passed to IPEX
